_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for the Burst Fusion step: the source folder and the same-molecule threshold on the left, the P_same curve that the threshold is read off, and the before/after comparison plots and summary table that show what fusing does to the bursts.

sections.label: Burst folder
sections.description: The burst-analysis folder to fuse — the output of burst selection. Nothing in it is modified; the fused bursts go to a new folder beside it.

sections.label: Fuse if P(same) ≥
sections.description: Two consecutive bursts are fused while the probability that they are the same molecule is at least this. 1 fuses nothing; low values eventually merge different molecules.

sections.label: Never bridge gaps >
sections.description: Ceiling on the gap fusion may bridge, whatever the probability says (0 removes it). A fused burst is one interval on disk, so bridging a gap puts its background photons inside the burst.

sections.label: Max fragments per burst
sections.description: Largest number of original bursts one fused burst may contain (0 = no limit). Caps runaway chains in dense data.
What the current threshold implies and what the last run produced.

sections.title: Summary
sections.description: Every burst identifier fusion changes, before and after. It sits beside the threshold on purpose — this is the answer the threshold is chosen against.

sections.label: Shortest lag
sections.description: Shortest inter-burst lag the correlation is evaluated at.

sections.label: Longest lag
sections.description: Longest lag evaluated. A threshold the curve never falls below inside this range leaves the window unresolved.

sections.label: Lag bins
sections.description: Logarithmic lag bins between the shortest and longest lag.

sections.label: Min pairs per bin
sections.description: Burst pairs a lag bin needs before it may end the fusion window. Stops a hole in sparse statistics reading as a confident 'different molecule'.

sections.label: Pool measurements
sections.description: Estimate one curve from every measurement of the folder (lags always stay inside a measurement). A single short file rarely has enough burst pairs on its own.

sections.label: Record grouping in the source folder
sections.description: Write an fg4 companion beside the original bursts giving each one its fused-burst number, so the grouping can be inspected or gated on there.

sections.title: Same-molecule probability
sections.description: P_same(tau) = 1 - 1/G(tau) from the burst arrival times. The dashed line is the threshold, the dotted line the gap actually fused up to.

sections.title: Proximity ratio
sections.description: Burst proximity ratio before and after fusion. Before the folder is written this is the fragments' own photons; afterwards it is the emitted bursts, which also contain the photons between fragments.

sections.title: Photons per burst
sections.description: Fusion moves weight out of the short-burst tail: the fragments of one passage become one brighter burst.

sections.title: Burst duration
sections.description: Durations after fusion include the bridged gaps, so this is where an over-permissive threshold shows first.

sections.title: Fragments per fused burst
sections.x_label: original bursts in one fused burst
sections.description: How many bursts were merged into each fused burst. A long tail means chains are forming — cap them with the fragment limit.
